Rendering re-check: the rendered QF_LIA text asserts exactly the six facts above (p>=1, p<=12, e>=1, e<=12, 2e+3p=17, e-p>=2) and nothing else; term order (+ (* 2 e) (* 3 p)) is the renderer's sorted-name convention, semantically identical to 3p+2e.

Hand analysis of the rendered model (independent of any solver): 3p+2e=17 with p,e in [1,12] forces e=7-p... enumeration: p=1 -> e=7 (e-p=6>=2, feasible); p=3 -> e=4 (e-p=1<2, infeasible); no other integer solutions. Expected verdict under the rendered model: AGREE_SAT with witness (p,e)=(1,7).
